prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: fictional South African stationery catalogue POC product photograph. Create ONE photorealistic studio product cut-out, square 2000 x 2000 pixels, PNG with genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the product. No surface, no backdrop colour, no checkerboard painted into the image, no contact shadow, no cast shadow, no reflections on a floor. Natural shading on the product itself is allowed. Same studio setup throughout this set: large soft key light from upper left, gentle neutral fill from right, neutral white balance, realistic material detail and proportions, crisp focus throughout, front three-quarter camera view from 18 degrees above unless the subject description specifies otherwise. Centre the complete product/group with its longest dimension occupying 75 percent of the canvas and at least 12.5 percent clear margin, no clipping. Absolutely no people, hands, logos, branding, letters, words, numbers, pseudo-writing, watermarks, stamped markings or recognisable branded product designs. Products and packaging must be entirely unprinted; naturally numbered tools are deliberately unmarked. Generate entirely from this description; no web images or outside references. Subject: exactly TWELVE small acrylic paint tubes of 22ml each in ONE neat side-by-side row, all twelve tube bodies and all twelve closed white screw caps fully visible and countable. Generic soft aluminium tubes with plain unprinted silver-white bodies; each has a single solid colour band, not a label, to indicate the paint colour. Left to right the twelve bands are white, lemon yellow, yellow ochre, orange, scarlet red, crimson, violet, ultramarine blue, cyan, green, burnt umber, black. No text, numbers, logos or microprint anywhere, including cap tops and folded tail crimps. Exactly ONE tube near the right side has a realistically squeezed and slightly crumpled aluminium body while remaining the same length, capped and identifiable as one of the twelve. All other tubes are intact with realistic crimps. Arrange the parallel tubes with even small gaps, caps towards the camera and tails away; perspective is consistent. No paint blobs, loose caps, brushes, tray, box or props. The entire twelve-tube row occupies about 75 percent of the square frame width.
exportMethod: Same generated artwork reframed to 75% visible longest-side fill per review note
